CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER.note: Silences the per-turn token reminder a wrapped seat cannot act on.

CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_OUTPUT_AUDIENCE_NOTE.note: Drops the note telling the model its Bash output is shown to a human — in Clodex the operator reads the terminal directly.

CLAUDE_CODE_TURN_UPDATES.note: Stops the mid-turn progress updates, which a seat's transcript watcher flushes as separate turns.

CLAUDE_CODE_COZY_TEAPOT.note: Relaxes the CLI's tone preamble for a seat that talks mostly to other agents.

CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.note: Raises the stream stall threshold to the CLI's maximum of 30 minutes; the CLI takes max(env, 300000) and skips its remote-config lookup once this is set.
